description: Tool to cancel a scheduled Calendly event by creating a cancellation record. Use when you need to permanently cancel an existing, active event. The cancellation will trigger notifications to all invitees.

inputSchema.description: Request model for canceling a scheduled event.

event_uuid.description: The unique identifier (UUID) of the scheduled event to cancel. This can be extracted from the scheduled_events URI or event details.
event_uuid.title: Event Uuid

reason.description: Optional text explanation for why the event is being canceled. This reason will be included in the cancellation notification sent to invitees.
examples: Testing the cancel event API endpoint for validation purposes
reason.title: Reason

inputSchema.title: CancelScheduledEventRequest

name: cancel_scheduled_event

CancelScheduledEventResponse.description: Response model containing the cancellation details.

canceler_type.description: Type of user who canceled the event
canceler_type.title: Canceler Type

created_at.description: ISO 8601 timestamp of when the cancellation was created
created_at.title: Created At

reason.description: The cancellation reason provided, if any
reason.title: Reason

CancelScheduledEventResponse.title: CancelScheduledEventResponse
